name: cli-agent-orchestrator-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is CLI Agent Orchestrator (CAO), which runs and coordinates terminal coding agents. This
task covers three of its subsystems: the persistent memory system with its wiki, retention, archive and self-learning
layers; workflows, from the `cao_workflow` script shim, linting and spec validation to the run journal and its
retention; and the unified configuration and settings services with the `cao config`, `cao memory` and
`cao workflow` commands.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the cli_agent_orchestrator package (under src/cli_agent_orchestrator/): constants.py; services/audit_log.py, services/cleanup_service.py, services/config_service.py, services/learned_patterns.py, services/memory_format.py, services/memory_reconciliation.py, services/memory_relationship_service.py, services/memory_scoring.py, services/memory_service.py, services/outcome_service.py, services/promotion_service.py, services/script_lint.py, services/script_runner.py, services/secret_gate.py, services/settings_service.py, services/step_output_store.py, services/wiki_compiler.py, services/wiki_healer.py, services/wiki_lint.py, services/workflow_journal.py, services/workflow_retention.py, services/workflow_service.py and services/workflow_spec_service.py; every module in services/memory_archive/; models/memory.py, models/workflow.py and models/workflow_runtime.py; utils/path_validation.py, utils/path
